body.p: Sands & McDougall's Melbourne and Suburban Directory for 1879.
A copy of the full directory is held by Melbourne History Resources, and you can read it online.

The 1879 directory has its own section for "Carlton and North Carlton, including Parkville" (pp. 61–81), bounded by Parkside-street to the north, Victoria-street east to the south, Nicholson-street to the east and Flemington-road to the west. It lists the streets alphabetically, four columns to a page, each house by house with the cross streets in order. The Carlton and North Carlton streets are included here, with Sydney-road as in the 1880 directory. The Parkville streets the section names (Bayles, Degraves, Fitzgibbon, Gatehouse, Morrah, Park and Wimble), and Royal Park, Royal Park-road, Flemington-road, Manningham, Southgate and the Church-street off Flemington-road, are left out. A few cross-street lines print Rathdowne-street or Neil-street; they are stored as Rathdown and Neill streets to match the later years.
